adaptationNotice: Independent, source-grounded commercial-solar adaptation. It is not endorsed by Jeremy Miner or 7th Level. Solar facts come from the supplied Solar Future Scotland PPA situation playbook; method language is an original NEPQ adaptation, not transcript text.
ethicalBoundaries: Use neutral, truthful questions; do not manipulate emotion or manufacture a problem.
Respect explicit opt-outs and end the call without another sales question.
Do not bypass landlords, finance, procurement, or other real decision participants.
Verify commercial and site fit before asking for commitment.
Present only facts supported by the prospect's situation and approved evidence.
